metadata.note: Verbatim extraction; no wording, option or order has been altered. Typos and inconsistencies in source are preserved and logged in docs/20_OPEN_ISSUES_AND_DECISIONS.md.

branching_rules_source.action: Show Sections A and B
branching_rules_source.implementation: Do not allow respondent to skip current class or current stream unless the question explicitly offers Not applicable / undecided.
branching_rules_source.data_handling: Store all answers with questionnaire version V1.1.

branching_rules_source.action: Show STU_D09_SCI and STU_D10_SCI
branching_rules_source.implementation: Hide all Commerce, Arts/Humanities and Vocational/Other D09-D10 questions.
branching_rules_source.data_handling: Hidden questions should be NULL / Not Displayed, not zero.

branching_rules_source.action: Show STU_D09_COM and STU_D10_COM
branching_rules_source.implementation: Hide all other stream-specific D09-D10 questions.
branching_rules_source.data_handling: Record display status separately from answer status.

branching_rules_source.action: Show STU_D09_ART and STU_D10_ART
branching_rules_source.implementation: Hide all other stream-specific D09-D10 questions.
branching_rules_source.data_handling: Record display status separately from answer status.

branching_rules_source.action: Show STU_D09_VOC and STU_D10_VOC
branching_rules_source.implementation: Hide all other stream-specific D09-D10 questions.
branching_rules_source.data_handling: If Other is selected, allow the student to describe stream/course.

branching_rules_source.action: Hide all stream-specific questions
branching_rules_source.implementation: Keep common D questions visible only if they can be answered meaningfully; allow Not applicable.
branching_rules_source.data_handling: Do not force a stream selection.

branching_rules_source.action: Hide STU_A13
branching_rules_source.implementation: Store STU_A13 as Not Displayed.

branching_rules_source.action: Hide STU_C07
branching_rules_source.implementation: If Yes (seriously/briefly), show STU_C07.

branching_rules_source.action: Hide STU_K11 and STU_K12
branching_rules_source.implementation: If Yes or Maybe, show K11 and K12.

branching_rules_source.trigger: STU_J01 includes No access to a digital device
branching_rules_source.action: Do not allow other device options simultaneously
branching_rules_source.implementation: If any device is selected, remove No access to a digital device.

branching_rules_source.action: Do not allow other interruption options simultaneously
branching_rules_source.implementation: Maximum three selections otherwise.

branching_rules_source.action: Do not allow any other support-needs options simultaneously
branching_rules_source.implementation: Maximum three selections otherwise.

branching_rules_source.action: Do not allow other pathway options simultaneously
branching_rules_source.implementation: If another pathway is selected, remove Not decided.

branching_rules_source.action: Do not allow other career areas simultaneously
branching_rules_source.implementation: Maximum three selections otherwise.

branching_rules_source.action: Do not allow other barrier options simultaneously
branching_rules_source.implementation: Not sure may be treated as exclusive as well.

branching_rules_source.action: Do not allow other support priority options simultaneously
branching_rules_source.implementation: Maximum three selections otherwise.

branching_rules_source.action: Show neutral confirmation / flag for data review
branching_rules_source.implementation: Do not block submission; age range is a data-quality prompt, not an eligibility rule.
branching_rules_source.data_handling: Preserve entered value and audit flag.

branching_rules_source.action: Reject invalid numeric value
branching_rules_source.implementation: Allow blank or Prefer not to say if UI provides it.

branching_rules_source.trigger: STU_B06 / STU_B07 / STU_E06 etc. multi-select limits
branching_rules_source.action: Enforce stated maximum selections
branching_rules_source.implementation: Do not silently truncate selections.
branching_rules_source.data_handling: Show user a clear validation message.

branching_rules_source.action: Offer separate secure contact-request workflow
branching_rules_source.implementation: Explain who will contact the student, for what purpose, and how contact data will be protected.
branching_rules_source.data_handling: Do not store contact details in the research response table.

branching_rules_source.action: Allow Prefer not to answer / skip where provided
branching_rules_source.implementation: Do not calculate a mental-health diagnosis or risk score from these responses.
branching_rules_source.data_handling: Have a safeguarding/referral protocol and trained responsible person before deployment.

branching_rules_source.action: Do not include that respondent's data in optional research use
branching_rules_source.implementation: Retain only what is necessary for service delivery/legal obligations; explain this in consent notice.
branching_rules_source.data_handling: Apply documented retention and deletion rules.

branching_rules_source.trigger: Any conditional question hidden by logic
branching_rules_source.action: Set response status to Not Displayed
branching_rules_source.implementation: Do not code as zero, No, or missing response.

branching_rules_source.action: Set response status to Skipped / Prefer not to answer as applicable
branching_rules_source.implementation: Do not infer a negative response.
